card.name: Condition named after 'until' when holding doses
card.fires_on: The noun for an adverse event or infection right after 'until the' or 'until adverse', in instructions to withhold or interrupt a drug. It marks the spot just before 'resolves', 'improves' or 'has resolved'.

modes.label: Infection until resolved
modes.description: The word infection after 'withholding the drug until the' in serious-infection warnings.
modes.example: consider withholding VYVGART HYTRULO until the<< infection>> has resolved.

modes.label: Adverse reaction until improves
modes.description: The word reaction after 'until the adverse' in dose-hold instructions.
modes.example: Withhold BLENREP until adverse<< reaction>> improves to Grade 1 or less.

modes.label: Symptom list until improves
modes.description: A symptom such as vomiting at the end of a list after 'until', before improves.
modes.example: interrupt treatment until diarrhea and/or<< vomiting>> improves or returns to baseline.

card.writes: It seems to push the next words toward a verb saying the condition has cleared or improved, though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the problem named in a hold-the-drug-until-it-clears instruction, such as the infection or the adverse reaction.
